facts.text: Massachusetts College of Liberal Arts (MCLA) serves as the Commonwealth's public liberal arts college and a campus of the Massachusetts state university system.

sources.title: Mission Values | MCLA - Massachusetts College of Liberal Arts
sources.quote: Massachusetts College of Liberal Arts (MCLA) is the Commonwealth's public liberal arts college and a campus of the Massachusetts state university system.

facts.text: MCLA offers 85% tuition reduction programs for undergraduate students residing in Connecticut, Maine, New Hampshire, New York, Rhode Island, and Vermont.
